mkdir .toolbox
mkdir .toolbox/tasks
mkdir tasks

cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/legacy-task.yaml .toolbox/tasks/legacy-task.yaml
cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/bundled-task.yaml tasks/bundled-task.yaml

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN list
stdout 'legacy-task'
stdout 'bundled-task'

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN run legacy-task
stdout 'Status: ok'
stdout 'legacy-ok'

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN run bundled-task
stdout 'Status: ok'
stdout 'bundled-ok'

cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/dup-all-legacy.yaml .toolbox/tasks/dup-all-legacy.yaml
cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/dup-all-bundled.yaml tasks/dup-all-bundled.yaml
cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/dup-all-user.yaml home/.config/toolbox/tasks/dup-all-user.yaml

! exec $TOOLBOX_BIN list
stderr 'duplicate task "dup-all"'
stderr 'project-legacy'
stderr 'project-bundled'
stderr 'user'
